in_sanskrit.name: शुभश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shubhash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shubh', which means 'auspicious', 'propitious', or 'fortunate'. The suffix 'sh' is added to intensify the meaning of the name.

in_hindi.name: शुभश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shubhash in Hindi is composed of two words - 'shubh' and 'sh'. 'Shubh' means 'auspicious', 'propitious', or 'fortunate', and 'sh' is an intensifying suffix. Together, they mean 'highly auspicious', 'extremely fortunate', or 'very propitious'.

in_tamil.name: ஷுபஹாஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Shubhash in Tamil is derived from the words 'putham' and 'sha'. 'Putham' means 'auspicious', 'propitious', or 'fortunate', and 'sha' is an intensifying suffix. Together, they mean 'highly auspicious', 'extremely fortunate', or 'very propitious'.

in_telugu.name: షుబహేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Shubhash in Telugu is derived from the words 'subhama' and 'sha'. 'Subhama' means 'auspicious', 'propitious', or 'fortunate', and 'sha' is an intensifying suffix. Together, they mean 'highly auspicious', 'extremely fortunate', or 'very propitious'.
